children: Indian equities could outperform Asian peers excluding Japan if the AI trade unwinds sharply, Societe Generale's Frank Benzimra says in a note. "Value is outperforming momentum and growth, defensives are outperforming cyclicals, and India is outperforming the AI-heavy markets," he says. India's correlation with the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index diverges from the rest of Asia, suggesting diversification potential, he notes. Still, regional markets haven't materially benefited from equity outflows from Korea and Taiwan, and India lacks a positive domestic catalyst. SocGen retains a neutral allocation to India, judging it too early to call India a postmidterms winner. (jihye.lee@wsj.com)
